_comment: Ninja Attack Reaction. Targets a Ninja attack (ATTACK_CLASS_IN Ninja). Effect 1: MODIFY_ATTACK +1{p} on the targeted attack. Effect 2: INJECT_TRIGGER scope COMBAT (one-shot on current attack) injects a nested ON_HIT trigger. Nested trigger gated by LAST_CHAIN_ATTACK name 'Edge of Autumn' (matches the card name across all printings). On hit, if condition met: DRAW 1. No printed keywords to suppress.
